name: Okta — Identities
description: Pull user identities from Okta for identity-aware exposure management

steps.instruction: Log into your Okta Admin Console
Enter your Okta domain (e.g. 'yourcompany' from yourcompany.okta.com)
Click Create Token, give it a name, and copy the token value

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Okta. Check your domain and API token.

transform.expr: {'display_name': ((record.get('profile') or {}).get('firstName', '') + ' ' + (record.get('profile') or {}).get('lastName', '')).strip(), 'email': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('email', ''), 'login': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('login', ''), 'employee_number': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('employeeNumber', ''), 'user_id': record.get('id', '')}

{'department': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('department', ''), 'title': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('title', ''), 'manager': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('manager', ''), 'mobile_phone': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('mobilePhone', ''), 'user_type': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('userType', ''), 'organization': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('organization', ''), 'division': (record.get('profile') or {}).get('division', ''), 'status': record.get('status', ''), 'created': record.get('created', ''), 'last_updated': record.get('lastUpdated', ''), 'password_changed': record.get('passwordChanged', '')}
